reason: Reviewed lifecycle hooks, the Notifai skill, harness setup, CLI readiness and domain terms. Codex question cards now register on the User's devices whether or not a device answer can close them, and `ask` hands the card back without a transport preflight, so `native_question_unavailable` is no longer emitted. A card that differs from a hand-back registers as its own question instead of being refused; only a card repeating a settled question is refused. Card hook contexts now say a device answer arrives with its acknowledgement command without claiming it arrives in the card. The Codex harness reference and native-questions note describe both answer routes and the Orca/T3 plain-text terminal answers; doctor's shared-server line says a phone answer reaches the agent while the card can stay open. A guidance change note tells running sessions. No command, approval or setting is added. Plain-text card answers count only for open, unanswered card questions; a typed answer counts only in the app whose shape it is, elsewhere only a choice label. The Codex reference says the card can stay on screen after a device answer and that an expiry the card cannot show is silent, with notifai status showing the question ended.
